text: The robot handled a total of 14 out of 38 orders successfully over the week, averaging 116 seconds per order but with a median time of 95 seconds. The top failure reason was "unknown" issues, which affected 2 out of the 9 orders that had warnings [cite:7]. Slowest order was #2 (water bottle) taking 817 seconds to complete. To improve efficiency, focus on identifying and resolving "unknown" failures, especially for items like water bottles where they may be more prevalent or problematic.
